findings.description: Same four stalls, silent zero-byte close, 64 stalled POSTs reset the 65th client, all 38 accepted shapes agree. `55z2fol` sends three co-buffered chunked POSTs and receives three `200`s correctly paired, so the stall is a slot-holding defect rather than a desync. The process additionally needs non-zero `cache_ttl_ms`/`cache_bytes` to start.
findings.title: Same slot stall and 65th-connection reset; three co-buffered chunked POSTs stay correctly paired

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
